title: Sabriel
author: Garth Nix
summary: Raised at a boarding school beside a country without magic, a young woman receives her missing father's sword and bells. She must cross into the Old Kingdom, where the dead do not stay dead, to find him.
readIf: you like fantasy with real chills, a capable teenage heroine and an unusual take on necromancy.
skipIf: you prefer your magic bright and friendly, as the dead and the bells here are properly eerie.

pairings.reason: Another classic where magic has rules and costs, told in a calm, spare style.
A shorter, younger book with the same delicious creepiness around the edge of another world.
Adult, grittier and full of ghosts and secret rites, for readers who want the dark side turned up.
